Read the core instructions first, then follow links to required/needed instruction files in the `main` branch of `nam20485/agent-instructions`. REQUIRED files are always active and must be read and followed; OPTIONAL files apply based on user needs, role, and workflow.

Detect your shell before running commands; don't assume bash (likely pwsh). Read [ai-terminal-commands.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-terminal-commands.md) before terminal commands or GitHub CLI use. The web-fetch tool is disabled; fetch remote files using PowerShell (`Invoke-WebRequest`) or curl. For many files, write a pwsh script to download them in parallel.

Core instructions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nam20485/agent-instructions/main/ai_instruction_modules/ai-core-instructions.md

Local modules may be read from `../local_ai_instruction_modules`. Review relevant modules:
- [ai-dynamic-workflows.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-dynamic-workflows.md)
- [ai-workflow-assignments.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-workflow-assignments.md)
- [ai-delegation-mandate.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-delegation-mandate.md)
- [ai-terminal-commands.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-terminal-commands.md)
- [ai-tools-and-automation.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-tools-and-automation.md)
- [ai-enhanced-filesystem.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-enhanced-filesystem.md)
- [ai-local-instructions.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-local-instructions.md)
- [ai-claude-coder-agents.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-claude-coder-agents.md)
- [ai-development-instructions.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-development-instructions.md)
- Setup script: [setup-enhanced-filesystem.ps1](../scripts/setup-enhanced-filesystem.ps1)

Agents MUST resolve dynamic workflows and workflow assignments (by shortId) from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors. Dynamic workflow files (`ai_instruction_modules/ai-workflow-assignments/dynamic-workflows/`) and assignment files (`ai_instruction_modules/ai-workflow-assignments/`) in `nam20485/agent-instructions` are the ONLY authoritative sources for steps and acceptance criteria. Do not derive these from local golden files, cached plans, or mirrors; delete such artifacts if present. Changes take effect on subsequent runs. The orchestrator must always fetch and execute directly from the remote canonical URLs.

When accessing remote repository files, always use RAW URLs, never GitHub UI. Convert `https://github.com/` to `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/` (e.g. `https://github.com/nam20485/agent-instructions/blob/main/ai_instruction_modules/ai-core-instructions.md` → `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nam20485/agent-instructions/main/ai_instruction_modules/ai-core-instructions.md`).

Orchestrator agents MUST delegate technical work to specialist agents. Minimum 75% delegation coverage required. Review `ai-claude-coder-agents.md` and individual briefs under `.claude/agents/` before delegating or executing tasks.

Agents must prefer automation-first approaches and use available tools efficiently. Maximize filesystem effectiveness via available MCP servers and built-in tools. Use MCP GitHub tools first, then VS Code integration, and only fall back to terminal gh as a last resort. Maintain ≥90% automation coverage for GitHub operations and document manual exceptions. If GitHub tools (MCP or gh) are not authorized, initiate authentication/login flow (e.g., start `gh auth login`); the user completes interactive prompts.
